items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Rushing told me, he said, 'Don't worry about it.' ... So he told Rushing to call me. And Rushing said, 'No, I ain't going to call him.'

ctx.x: And so, Jimmy Rushing told me, he said, 'Don't worry about it. I bet you Shadow won't be in the band a good month.' I said --
